adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`, `update` does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` immediately dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), so if the record isn’t found (`host` is `nil`) this will raise a `NoMethodError` and produce a 500 rather than a 404/not-found response. The diff shows no guard or `find_by!`/`raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` handling.
